title: Heading + body + CTA
description: Any single message that needs one action. Use on white between richer modules.
usage: Workhorse 1-column block. One idea, one action. Centre-aligned. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.
notes: Mobile: section padding 48 snaps to 32 left/right (mobPad32), 40 top (padd-top) and 30 bottom (mob-pad-bot); Figma is 32 all round.
Mobile: stack gaps 24 snap to 20 (himobtop); Figma is 16.
Heading uses f24 (28 → 24, line-height normal) per the convention table; the Figma Mobile frame keeps 28px.
